implementation.existingCooldownModificationPreserved: The existing RC108 EGO/resonance entry policy can reduce the remaining cooldown by 7%; 77 is the base, not an invariant displayed value.
implementation.revivalLimit: One lethal revival per zone encounter. Changing zones resets the charge but does not clear remaining cooldown. A new wave in the same zone does not refill it.
stateFixes: hero change cannot transfer active awakening
map/mode changes clear owned active state
implementation.art: Reuses the existing eight distinct transparent awakening PNGs. New owner-specific motifs, color overlays, short portrait cut-ins, timer labels, shockwaves and restrained vignette were implemented; no claim of eight newly generated illustrations.
implementation.monochrome: DREAM grayscale precedes the colored owner overlay; the STORY final encounter remains fully monochrome after overlays.
implementation.hitPause: Bounded enemy-side pauses through the existing timeStopUntil mechanism, not global player freezes. Repeated laser and identified damage-over-time pauses are excluded.
preserved: committed boss cast completion including cosmic masked Lucifer
